test_cases.title: Applicant opens the maintain species data page and sees the maintenance actions
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the maintain species data page and sees the maintenance actions - features/maintain-species-data/maintain-species-data.feature:6

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 with an account that has the ProfileEditor role
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the maintain species data page
steps.expected: The maintain species data page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Check the maintain species data page content
steps.expected: The maintenance actions are visible

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

steps.action: Check the page heading
steps.expected: The page heading is visible
